audience: ML engineers and developers who run models and fine-tuning on Fireworks AI

useCases.title: Check which models and deployments are running
useCases.text: The AI lists the base and fine-tuned models, the deployments and the model-to-deployment bindings. You see what is serving in your account.

useCases.title: Track your fine-tuning jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists supervised fine-tuning jobs and reads one job in detail. You see which jobs exist and how each one is going.

useCases.title: Review your batch inference jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists the batch inference jobs in the account. You get an overview of what was submitted.

useCases.title: Look up datasets or add a dataset record
useCases.text: The AI lists datasets and reads one by id. It can also create a dataset metadata record; the data itself is uploaded separately.

useCases.title: Shut down a deployment you no longer need
useCases.text: The AI finds the deployment and deletes it. This stops serving that model and stops its billing, so check the id first.
